rationale: Hold: nothing already planned changes of substance; this extends the horizon to 22 Nov and adds a calf condition. 2-8 Nov is the first November build week (~62 km, no quality, first 18 km long run with gels), firm, with a graded leg-gym return after the 28 Oct calf tightness. 9-15 and 16-22 Nov are provisional: quality returns on the 11th and 14th with volume held at ~64 km, then the third week adds only the long run (20 km) and a small step, quality unchanged, so volume and intensity never rise together. The first quality session back is conditional on the calf being silent.

changes.notes: Rest. Day after Guy Fawkes. Log the race, the calf and what you took.
Easy 12 km, genuinely easy; the longer Tuesday run starts at the bottom of its 18-20 km range. If the left calf is tight from the race, cut to 8 and tell me. Judge it on feel, not pace.
Easy 8 km. Leg gym back in (calf, soleus, single-leg, RDL), graded rather than heavy this first week given the calf on 28 Oct.
Easy 10 km + 4 strides. No tempo this week: volume rises, so intensity does not.

Long run 18 km, easy (~5:00/km or slower), the start of the Nov 18-22 km progression. Gel at ~20 min and again at ~60 min, a first gut-training step; log what you took. No pace work. Only if achilles 0 with no prodrome, calf quiet, and HRV/RHR steady.

Provisional — 3 km warm-up with pickups (buff over the mouth until you start), 4x1 km at 3:38-3:40/km with 90 s jog, 3 km cool-down, ~11.5 km all in. Reopens speed gently after the racing block. Conditional on the left calf being silent through the week before; if not, easy 8 instead. Put the paces on the watch.
Provisional — 3 km warm-up, 2x12 min at 3:50-3:53/km with 2 min jog, 3 km cool-down, ~13 km all in. Cold air: longer warm-up with pickups, buff, log any chest symptoms.

Provisional — Long run 18 km easy (~5:00/km or slower), second week at this level; gels at ~20 and ~60 min, log what you took. Only if achilles 0 and HRV/RHR steady. Week ~64 km: volume held, not raised, because intensity returned.

Provisional — 3 km warm-up with pickups, 5x1 km at 3:38-3:40/km with 90 s jog, 3 km cool-down, ~12.5 km all in. One rep more than the 11th, same pace; goes ahead only if the 11th was clean and the calf silent.
Provisional — Easy 6 km. Leg gym on or after today.
Provisional — Same as 14 Nov: 3 km warm-up, 2x12 min at 3:50-3:53/km, 2 min jog, 3 km cool-down. Same quality as the week before; only the long run steps up.
Provisional — Long run 20 km easy (~5:00/km or slower); gel from 20 min then every ~25 min, log what you took. Week ~66 km. Only if achilles 0, calf quiet, HRV/RHR steady; otherwise hold at 18.
